answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy can employ a robust reputation-staking mechanism. Each agent must lock a substantial deposit of native tokens, creating a financial barrier to entry. This mitigates attacks where an attacker would otherwise generate an ocean of fake identities. The economic cost ensures that even at the nadir of an attack's success, the monetary outlay to create new fake agents remains prohibitively high, especially as new agents emerge with the dawn of each operational cycle, demanding proportional collateral.
